sents.t: The Super Bowl is the biggest sports event of the year in America.
It’s the final game of the football season.
This year, Carlos had a Super Bowl party, and he invited me, Emma, Danny.
Carlos’s fiancée, Ana, was there too.
She is a nurse at Oakville Hospital, and she is friendlier than anyone I know.
Danny brought chicken wings, which were spicier than I expected.
Emma made guacamole, and I brought chips and salsa.
I don’t really understand American football.
“It’s more complicated than soccer,” I told Danny.
“It’s easier than it looks,” he said.
“Each team tries to carry the ball to the end zone. That’s a touchdown.”
Half the people at the party were watching the game, and the other half were watching the commercials.
Super Bowl commercials are more expensive than any others, so they are often funnier and more creative.
In the end, our team lost by three points.
Danny was sad, but Carlos said, “The food was better than the game!” I agreed.

o: the final game of the football season
